notes.title: Small Patch April 1st 2024
notes.content: There was a slight bug causing Govee light sync not to work some times.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 16th 2024
notes.content:
This update brings in Govee RGB Support.

Some Govee light products support being controlled via something known as the LAN API.
To enable, go into the Govee app, and enable the LAN API for each device you wish to be controlled by MyLittleCloud.

This should allow my MyLittleCloud to control your Govee light products to match the lightning.

Note, sometimes it may take MyLittleCloud a few min to find the Govee hardware on the network. If it isn't working right away, try connecting to the 2.4G band instead of the 5G.

Hope you enjoy,
Devaraber

notes.title: Update Notes For July 12th
notes.content:
Improved rain drop visibility.
 Improved rain splash visibility.
 Improved mist visibility and motion.
 Added ability to change particle counts


Note, Rain, splash and mist settings only set the theoretical maximum particle counts, and not the actual particle counts. The Cloud particle count will change the amount of particles in the Cloud at any time.

P.S You can take screenshots with F12.

notes.title: Improved Visuals
notes.content:
Improved Cloud Particle Physics to make the cloud feel more real and alive.
 Fixed a clipping issue where the top of the cloud would get clipped off.
 Improved Lightning.

notes.title: Major Content Update!
notes.content:
Just released is a massive content update for My Little Cloud:

1) My Little Cloud now allows you to switch between rain track depending on the mode, and adds 11 new Light rain tracks:
https://i.imgur.com/KFi7GCO.png https://i.imgur.com/fiMrrYA.png

2) My Little Cloud now has an integrated online radio, the idea here is to play lofi, classical, or other types of music in combination with the thunder and rain!
https://i.imgur.com/0CyhD9G.png

3) The Radio, rain and lightning volumes are all visible in the mixer so you can get your atmosphere just right ːsteamhappyː
https://i.imgur.com/yMTfAkq.png

4) More setting have been added so you can get into your preferred mode, with your preferred rain track and radio channel all ready to go as you left them on start of My Little Cloud:
https://i.imgur.com/4YbiH0a.png

Please do enjoy, and do not hesitate to contact me if you have any issues with the update!

Regards,
Khaled
Developer of My Little Cloud

notes.title: Major Graphics 3D Overhaul
notes.content:
Improvements:
[olist]
 Overall Graphical Improvements.
 Allows the user to rotate around the cloud in 3D.
 Reduces CPU usage by close to half of the 2D version.
[/olist]

Controls:

 Rotate Cloud Left: (A) or (←) or (Scroll) while the mouse is on top of the cloud.
 Rotate Cloud Right (D) or (→) or (Scroll) while the mouse is on top of the cloud.
 Zoom In (W) or (↑) or (Ctrl +) or (Ctrl + Scroll) while the mouse is on top of the cloud.
 Zoom Out (S) or (↓) or (Ctrl -) or (Ctrl + Scroll) while the mouse is on top of the cloud.


If you wish to go back to the 2D version:
[olist]
 Click on the app settings in Steam.
 Go to the Betas tab.
 Select MLC2D from the drop-down.
[/olist]

I hope you all enjoy it!
